CustomField.description: Affichage metier du Purchase Price: entier pour JPY/KRW, decimales conservees pour les autres devises.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Purchase_Price__c), "", IF( OR(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = "JPY", TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = "KRW"), TEXT(ROUND(Purchase_Price__c, 0)) & " " & TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode), TEXT(Purchase_Price__c) & " " & TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) ) )
CustomField.label: Purchase Price
